title: Certificate proofs after the TLS handshake
claim: Modeled on draft-sullivan-tls-exported-authenticator-00. A method comprising: exporting a certificate ownership proof after the TLS handshake for transmission out of band to the peer; constructing that proof as Certificate, CertificateVerify, and Finished messages; and requiring the receiver to check a DNSSEC authenticated per certificate epoch counter to reject proofs issued before the current epoch.

elements.element: Certificate ownership proofs outside the connection
elements.question: Did anyone describe exporting a certificate ownership proof after a TLS handshake for transmission out of band and verification by the peer?
Did anyone describe constructing an exportable TLS certificate ownership proof as a sequence of Certificate, CertificateVerify, and Finished messages?

elements.element: DNSSEC epoch checks for proof revocation
elements.question: Did anyone describe revoking exportable TLS certificate ownership proofs by requiring receivers to check a DNSSEC authenticated per certificate epoch counter and reject proofs from earlier epochs?
